name: Plague Archon

Traits.name: Bloodied Burst
Traits.text: The first time the plague archon is Bloodied in a fight, it releases a burst. *Constitution Saving Throw*: DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the plague archon. *Failure:* 31 (9d6) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn. *Success:* Half damage only.

Traits.name: Aura of Authority
Traits.text: While in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the plague archon, the plague archon and its allies have Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws, provided the plague archon doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The plague archon makes three attacks, using Forelimb or Swarm Bite in any combination.

Actions.name: Forelimb
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 5 ft. 18 (3d8 + 5) Slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) Poison damage.

Actions.name: Swarm Bite
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 5 ft. 29 (7d6 + 5) Piercing damage.

Bonus Actions.name: Quarry Command
Bonus Actions.text: *Wisdom Saving Throw:* DC 17, one creature within 30 feet. *Failure:* Until the start of the plague archon's next turn, the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than the plague archon.

lore: A blessed warden of the plague-god died mid-ritual, and the flies drawn to its sanctified rot fused into a chitinous archon that raises the surrounding swarm as its congregation, spreading the contagion it was meant to ward against.

generation.userConcept: a plague-bearing archon of flies that commands lesser swarms

monsterDescription: a plague-bearing archon of flies that commands lesser swarms
